nodes.label: First real game-event FX binding uses Squirrel HitPoints polling
nodes.norm_label: first real game-event fx binding uses squirrel hitpoints polling
nodes.rationale: Avoids another reverse-engineered damage RVA while using proven DLL config-setter hook and GPU effect director.

nodes.label: Gate Route-B menu pointer on native menu draw frames
nodes.norm_label: gate route-b menu pointer on native menu draw frames
nodes.rationale: Earlier tests fired during gameplay because RmlUi menus are not represented by gameUiActive_.

nodes.label: Add Nemyax-parity full-prune exporter
nodes.rationale: Original full-prune failure may have been confounded by leaf-only node rebuild rather than subobject removal alone.

nodes.label: Physical reload visuals should be transient objects
nodes.norm_label: physical reload visuals should be transient objects
nodes.rationale: Current evidence supports writing CameraObj and JointPos, not arbitrary runtime subobject ownership changes.

nodes.label: Pistol muzzle flash follows via flash-object CameraObj
nodes.norm_label: pistol muzzle flash follows via flash-object cameraobj
nodes.rationale: User reports pistol flash stays at native position while laser follows; AE source shows flash objects have their own CameraObj.

nodes.label: Right-arm ammo HUD should use native overlay rects
nodes.norm_label: right-arm ammo hud should use native overlay rects
nodes.rationale: Percentage lower-right slice is unstable in inventory mode; native overlay rects are the proven engine seam for layout.

nodes.label: Right-arm ammo HUD should be a separate cropped quad
nodes.norm_label: right-arm ammo hud should be a separate cropped quad
nodes.rationale: User wants a small right-arm hologram behind the weapon, not the full HUD or left-hand wrist panel.

nodes.label: Snap-turn v2 uses accumulator/body transport
nodes.rationale: Earlier direct-yaw paths produced wrong-way turns and flash frames; smooth-turn work proved KEX accumulator is the stable route.

nodes.label: v1.42 restores inventory visibility
nodes.rationale: User testing showed right-arm HUD experiment blanked inventory and left-stick movement failed.

nodes.label: Separate tracked and fallback weapon viewmodel scale
nodes.norm_label: separate tracked and fallback weapon viewmodel scale
nodes.rationale: Live testing showed 0.65 scale feels too small in tracked pose after native-KEX-frame remap, while 1.0 makes fallback pose huge.

nodes.label: Resolved: command-bridge buttons dead — null g_kexBase
nodes.norm_label: resolved: command-bridge buttons dead — null g_kexbase
nodes.rationale: g_kexBase was null when suppress_bridge_echo=false, causing CallKexSetConfigRawNoThrow to silently drop commands.

nodes.label: Failure: Chased a framerate regression — Windows desktop refresh
nodes.norm_label: failure: chased a framerate regression — windows desktop refresh
nodes.rationale: Desktop refresh rate reset to 50 Hz, capping the VR pipeline via vsync; not a code regression.

nodes.label: Failure: Echo suppressor wrote suppressed vars via trampoline
nodes.norm_label: failure: echo suppressor wrote suppressed vars via trampoline
nodes.rationale: Trampoline bypasses DLL's own Hook_SetConfigRaw, so selection/frob vars never reached the DLL consumer.

nodes.label: Trap: an Info-level diagnostic is silently discarded
nodes.norm_label: trap: an info-level diagnostic is silently discarded
nodes.rationale: Diagnostic produced zero lines because live ini runs log_level=warn, filtering out LogLevel::Info.

nodes.label: Failure: Packing AE KPF entries with Windows backslashes
nodes.norm_label: failure: packing ae kpf entries with windows backslashes
nodes.rationale: KPF entries with backslashes are not found by KEX; entries must use forward slashes for scripts to load.

nodes.label: Failure: +jump / +crouchhold console verbs are no-ops
nodes.rationale: Bind-action strings have no static xrefs; fixed by calling native SetPosture and jump bind handlers directly.

nodes.label: Resolved: VR froze on block — OpenXR 16-layer limit
nodes.norm_label: resolved: vr froze on block — openxr 16-layer limit
nodes.rationale: Crossing the 16-layer guarantee caused XR_ERROR_LAYER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, freezing the HMD.

nodes.label: Lesson: NEVER use a pausing debugger on the LIVE VR game
nodes.norm_label: lesson: never use a pausing debugger on the live vr game
nodes.rationale: Pausing the process causes the VR compositor to time out and kill the app; use non-pausing Frida hooks instead.

nodes.label: Lesson: Squirrel KEYWORD used as table member fails compile
nodes.norm_label: lesson: squirrel keyword used as table member fails compile
nodes.rationale: Using 'base' as a member name caused a parse error that failed the entire file compile, breaking all shared helpers.

nodes.label: Resolved: parry enemy-pipe read — static-RE recipes failed
nodes.norm_label: resolved: parry enemy-pipe read — static-re recipes failed
nodes.rationale: Four static-RE recipes failed because runtime state (globals, joint remaps) was never checked; fixed via Frida memory probes.

nodes.label: Hazard class: truncating writes to files we do not own
nodes.norm_label: hazard class: truncating writes to files we do not own
nodes.rationale: Non-atomic truncating writes destroyed kexengine.cfg and user KPFs; fixed by building into temp and atomically replacing.

nodes.label: Failure: Weapon-mesh Matrix flicker — mod not in mod_path
nodes.norm_label: failure: weapon-mesh matrix flicker — mod not in mod_path
nodes.rationale: Fix was installed in a mod folder but not listed in cam_user.cfg mod_path, so stock sshock2ee viewmodel.nut won.

nodes.label: Resolved: Weapon weighted-raw flicker — dtSec==0 ticks
nodes.norm_label: resolved: weapon weighted-raw flicker — dtsec==0 ticks
nodes.rationale: Spring block skipped on frames where GetTickCount64 delta was 0, causing weapon to snap to raw pose.
